dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 features used (EVALUATE, END-PERFORM, END-READ, END-IF, 88-level condition, GOBACK, reference modification). No vendor-specific extensions visible. Could be GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler given student context.

purpose.domain_detail: Student grade calculation program computing GPA averages from a text file of course grades
purpose.summary: Reads a file of course records (code, name, credit, grade) and computes overall GPA, science GPA, and computer science GPA using a weighted grade-point scale (A=4, B+=3.5, etc.). Results are written to an output file. The program categorizes courses by course code prefix to separate computer science from other science courses.

notable_features: EVALUATE TRUE with multiple WHEN clauses for grade-point mapping
88-level condition name used as end-of-file flag (HIGH-VALUE)
Reference modification for course code prefix checking (COURSE-CODE (1:1), COURSE-CODE (1:2))
PERFORM THRU with explicit EXIT paragraph
No COMP-3 or packed decimal usage despite numeric accumulation
verdict.notes: Filename 'my-grade.cbl' and AUTHOR 'THUN' strongly suggest a student assignment. The logic has minor issues (initial values of accumulators not explicitly set to zero, potential divide-by-zero if no science courses). One line slightly exceeds 72 characters (long_lines_over_72=1). Mixed case in 'SEQUeNTIAL' is unusual but valid in COBOL.
